gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2019, Syndicate 1458 experienced an unfavourable prior year reserve development of GBP 37.9 million, primarily driven by attritional claims and claims expenses following a deep dive on the Casualty book related to historical contracts now in run-off. This strengthening represents 3.93% of the opening gross claims outstanding. The year also saw an impact from 2019 catastrophe events including Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis, and Hurricane Dorian, totaling GBP 31.7 million. There was also a favourable development of GBP 1.7m on 2018 prior accident year losses.

During 2019 there was an adverse prior-accident-year development of GBP 37.9m (strengthening), driven primarily by attritional claims and claims expense deterioration following a deep-dive review of the Casualty book (historical contracts now in run-off). In addition the Syndicate recorded an aggregate net impact of GBP 31.7m from 2019 catastrophe events (Typhoon Faxai, Typhoon Hagibis and Hurricane Dorian) which contributed to the overall loss for the year.
